subject.title: fix(pr): bind review artifacts to the PR being landed

question: Should the landing-tool owners accept the new fail-closed artifact lifecycle after reviewing an end-to-end transcript that proves cross-PR rejection and matching-review preservation?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes internal maintainer automation semantics, and the supplied evidence demonstrates test coverage but not a real invocation of the landing workflow.

options.title: Request end-to-end proof
options.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript using the real `scripts/pr` flow to show foreign artifacts fail and current PR/head artifacts remain usable before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression coverage if maintainers judge the script fixtures to adequately represent the operational workflow.

recommendation.title: Request end-to-end proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript using the real `scripts/pr` flow to show foreign artifacts fail and current PR/head artifacts remain usable before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work places this contributor closest to the `scripts/pr` worktree and review-artifact behavior.
